items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I did the thing, Hello Dollar, I did the trumpet solo on that.

ctx.x: So with the Basie band, I'm looking at the discography again. There's a recording with Basie on June 8th, 1964, but with Frank Sinatra singing.
Yeah. Yeah. I did the thing, Hello Dollar, I did the trumpet solo on that.
Yeah, he recorded, yeah, he did a recording of Hello Dollar.
